definition: Making block-sparse attention a trainable, hardware-aligned part of pretraining rather than an inference-time patch: the model learns which blocks to attend to.
details: Making block-sparse attention a trainable, hardware-aligned part of pretraining rather than an inference-time patch: the model learns which blocks to attend to. The current frontier for long-context efficiency without post-hoc approximation error.

explainer.lead: It makes block-sparse attention a trainable, hardware-aligned part of pretraining instead of an inference-time patch, so the model learns which blocks to attend to. It matters as a route to long-context efficiency without post-hoc approximation error.

tiers.eli5: Rather than skimming the text faster only at the end, the model is taught from the start which chunks are worth reading closely.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers build block sparsity into pretraining and align it with hardware so the model learns block selection. A pitfall is that the approximation error of an inference-time patch is avoided, but the sparsity must be designed into training from the outset.
tiers.paperLevel: Block-sparse attention made trainable and hardware-aligned during pretraining; the model learns which blocks to attend to. It targets long-context efficiency without post-hoc approximation error.

explainer.example: During pretraining a long-context model learns to attend only to selected blocks of the input, cutting attention cost while staying hardware-aligned.
